description.description: A screenshot of a Daily Mail News article summarizing statements from a spokesperson for the US embassy in Israel regarding Tucker Carlson's visit to the country. The text refutes claims that Carlson was detained and clarifies the level of engagement the embassy had regarding his private plane landing.
description.ocrText: Daily Mail News. A spokesperson for the US embassy in Israel denied that Carlson was detained and claimed he 'received the same passport control questions that countless visitors to Israel including Ambassador Huckabee and other diplomats receive as part of normal entrance and exit from Israel.' 'It is not accurate that Israel only was going to let Tucker into the country for the interview,' the spokesperson added. 'The only engagement the Embassy had with Israel about his visit was to coordinate his private plane landing as part of facilitating a seamless visit. It was Tucker who chose to only come into the country for a few hours and depart. And Tucker received the same positive treatment of any visitors to Israel.'
